Hype4 Academy glassmorphism CSS generator

The web tool from the style’s namer that turns blur and transparency sliders into a copyable glass-card CSS rule.

Source
Hype4 Academy (SquarePlanet)
Creator
Hype4 Academy / Michał Malewicz
Style
Glassmorphism (tool; agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Airy, technical
Evidence
Read the page’s server-rendered HTML on 2026-09-28 and inspected its hero image glassmorphismHero.png (1602 × 870) in a scratchpad copy. Not stored. The interactive generator was not operated. The page is now branded SquarePlanet.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

The page calls itself “The original generator for Glassmorphism” and says it was “made by the person who created the glassmorphism name”. It credits Malewicz with coining the term and dates the initial article to November 2020. Hype4 Academy.

Its default output (blur 20, refraction 0.15, depth 10) is background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15), backdrop-filter: blur(20px), border-radius: 20px, border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), and a 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) shadow with inset white highlights, plus 1 px gradient lines on the top and left edges.

It depends on the CSS backdrop-filter property.

Observed

  • Hero image: a dark ‘Settings’ panel with Blur value, Refraction, and Depth sliders sits over a black 3D keyboard with one red key.
  • The part of the keyboard behind the panel is blurred and dimmed; the part outside it is sharp.
  • The panel has large rounded corners and a thin, lighter edge. Slider tracks are white with lime-green fills and white round thumbs.

Why it belongs

The generator’s defaults (15 % white fill, 20 px blur, 20 px radius, 1 px white border at 30 %) sit inside the ranges in the style’s rules. The newer ‘refraction’ control and edge highlights move the output toward Liquid Glass.

Borrow

Start a glass card from: 15 % white fill, 20 px backdrop blur, 20 px radius, 1 px border at 30 % white, and a 32 px soft shadow at 10 % black.
